title: [38ec-pre-core] Make live-quiesce evidence validation total
description: Prerequisite production leaf split from reopened task-38ec450ae92d486f860c5801c0f28870 after QA's exact hostile probes reproduced caller-visible RangeError/accessor escape in the core serializer. Objective: make the existing public live-quiesce serializer/digest total, exact-own-data, bounded, and canonical for hostile JavaScript values without changing its signature, valid bytes, seven-code vocabulary, or barrel. Deliverable: a focused internal safe JSON snapshot module and one-line bridge are consumed by the existing serializer before schema/semantic validation. Exact owned paths (4): packages/core/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-evidence-safe-value.ts (new); packages/core/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-evidence-safe-value.js (new one-line bridge); packages/core/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-evidence.ts; packages/core/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-evidence.test.ts. NOT in scope: daemon reads, migration writer, barrels, manifests/lock, reason vocabulary, or task-38ec's preserved security WIP. Exact verification command: `& {$p='pnpm.exe';function x{&$p @args;if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE}};x --filter @moe/core exec vitest run src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-evidence.test.ts;x --filter @moe/core typecheck}`.
definitionOfDone: Adopt the DONE/merged task-2bf8fa1a485146aa860bd0f50cbf8287 record, then re-measure the four paths, every direct serializer/digest caller and literal exact-shape/count assertion, production line counts, and the existing @moe/contracts manifest plus pnpm-lock importer edge. A deleted compiled probe inside @moe/core must import the needed limits from the bare @moe/contracts specifier and typecheck exit 0 before implementation.

Red-first extend the real public serializer/digest test with a nonzero generated hostile matrix covering a 20,000-deep value, enumerable throwing getter, revoked and ownKeys-throwing Proxy, symbol/non-enumerable/prototype extras, sparse arrays and extra array keys. Both public surfaces must never throw or invoke an accessor and must return exactly LIVE_QUIESCE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE at live-quiesce-evidence; independent exact case counts/sets must prove every case was generated and reached production.

Create a <=250-line internal safe-value module plus exact one-line .js bridge. It rejects proxies/exotic prototypes/accessors/symbol or non-enumerable keys/sparse or extra-index arrays/cycles, traverses iteratively through own data descriptors only, and bounds depth, work, scalar UTF-8 and final canonical bytes using existing contract limits before allocation can grow without bound. The public module validates and canonicalizes only the detached snapshot under a catch-all totality fence, preserves byte-identical canonical JSON/digests for valid evidence, keeps the seven-code roster/signatures unchanged, and remains <400 physical lines.

After exact-path status capture, mutate the production surface one mechanism at a time to restore recursive/Object.values traversal, permit an accessor, accept one hidden/prototype key or sparse hole, and bypass a depth/body bound. Each mutant must make its named production-surface code/layer, zero-accessor, exact-key/density, or bounded-totality assertion red; restore tracked paths with diff plus SHA equality and untracked paths from worker-suffixed out-of-tree backups with separate SHA256 equality proof.

Run the exact foreground/unpiped verification command and require Core Test Files 1 passed with a nonzero Tests count plus typecheck success. Then run the full @moe/core package and root lanes as merge-base-versus-HEAD path-attributed baselines, require no new failure intersecting the four owned paths, disclose foreign red verbatim, and record final line counts/bridge loadability.
taskRails: Own exactly the four listed paths. Do not edit daemon, migration, security-lane, barrel/index, manifest, lockfile, or foreign WIP.

Preserve the public function arity/types, valid canonical JSON/digest bytes, LIVE_QUIESCE_EVIDENCE_LAYER and exact seven-code roster. All hostile failures use existing LIVE_QUIESCE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE; do not mint a new public reason or repair/default caller data.

Validation must be total against arbitrary unknown values and must not invoke user accessors, proxy traps or iterators. A recursive walker, Object.values, JSON.stringify on unsnapshotted input, or try/catch without bounded detached traversal is not an acceptable fix.
The daemon bounded-reader child filed in the same split is the real production consumer and must declare this task in dependsOn before this leaf completes.

Verify all three @moe/contracts edge facts: core manifest declaration, pnpm-lock packages/core importer, and a same-command-created/deleted compiled probe inside @moe/core importing MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES, MAX_JSON_DEPTH and MAX_JSON_STRING_UTF8_BYTES from the bare specifier with exit 0. implementationPlan.description: TESTS FIRST — extend cutover-quiesce-evidence.test.ts against the real internal production snapshot seam and both public exports. Build each hostile value from an otherwise byte-identical valid evidence fixture and freeze a nonzero exact case roster covering: 20,000-deep nesting; enumerable throwing getter with invocation counter; revoked and ownKeys-throwing proxies; symbol, non-enumerable and inherited/prototype extras; sparse arrays and extra array keys; a schema-valid scalar above MAX_JSON_STRING_UTF8_BYTES; and a schema-valid aggregate above MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES. Assert every case is actually constructed and exercised, neither public call throws, both return exactly LIVE_QUIESCE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE at live-quiesce-evidence, no accessor/iterator is invoked, and no canonicalJson/digest escapes. For guards whose downstream schema would otherwise emit the same public tuple (notably deep invalid nesting/proxy catch), require the actual internal production seam's distinct frozen issue tag as the divergence oracle—never a test-side reimplementation. Pin the pre-edit literal canonical JSON/digest, insertion-order parity, arity 1 and seven-code identity for valid values. Run only this file and record named reds caused by missing safe seam/totality/bounds; an unrelated throw or zero generated cases is not TDD evidence.

MINIMUM IMPLEMENTATION — create cutover-quiesce-evidence-safe-value.ts (<=250 physical lines) and the exact one-line LF bridge `export * from "./cutover-quiesce-evidence-safe-value.ts";`. Implement a non-barrel internal result/issue union, iterative own-data snapshot and iterative bounded canonicalizer. Reject node:util/types isProxy values before reflective work; inside a catch fence require Object.prototype/null records or Array.prototype arrays, inspect Reflect.ownKeys plus own descriptors without reading accessors, reject symbols/non-enumerables/accessors/exotic prototypes/cycles, and require dense 0..length-1 enumerable data array slots with no extras. Enforce MAX_JSON_DEPTH, bounded work/length, MAX_JSON_STRING_UTF8_BYTES for keys/scalars, and an exact MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES canonical-output budget before joining output; copy only primitives into a detached graph. Refactor cutover-quiesce-evidence.ts to remove recursive isJsonValue/canonicalText, snapshot before any property/schema read, run existing exact-shape and semantic checks only on the detached value, canonicalize only after acceptance, and catch all remaining hostile failures into the existing INCOMPLETE code/layer without defaults. Keep valid canonical bytes/digests, public arities/types, seven-code roster and barrel untouched; keep evidence.ts <400 (target <=250 after extraction). Use the focused test as red/green feedback.

GREEN/PARITY REVIEW — finish the focused tests without weakening the independent rosters or golden. Add schema-valid large-string/body controls immediately below each ceiling so the bounds are not refusing all large values, and keep semantic count/stop/host refusals on their pre-existing exact codes. Exercise both insertion orders and repeated calls to prove detached snapshots prevent caller mutation/TOCTOU from changing the accepted canonical bytes; accepted returned key rosters remain exactly `{ok,canonicalJson}` and `{ok,quiesceRecordSha256}`. Review the four-path diff for no public export/constant/format fan-out, no recursive traversal, no caller object mutation, no credential/value echo in refusal detail, exact LF one-line bridge, and explanatory invariant comments inside the new internal module. No user-facing docs change is appropriate because no public signature, reason vocabulary or valid wire bytes change.

PENULTIMATE — perform one adversarial review and mutation sheet over exactly the four paths. First record exact-path porcelain; back up each untracked new module/bridge to worker-suffixed out-of-tree files and hash them. One at a time: route through recursive/Object.values traversal; skip proxy rejection so the throwing/revoked fixture reaches the catch; accept an accessor; ignore a hidden/prototype key; allow a sparse hole/extra index; raise the depth issue while leaving downstream schema intact; and bypass scalar/body ceilings using the otherwise-valid large controls. Require the named public code/layer/zero-call or internal issue-tag assertion to red for each mutant (not merely some refusal), with exact nonzero case counts. Restore after each. For tracked paths prove saved diff plus SHA equality; for initially untracked paths restore, then in a separate call prove SHA256 equality to the out-of-tree backup. Re-run the affected focused file after each restore, inspect totality, allocation, canonical order and TOCTOU as an attacker, require safe-value.ts <=250 and evidence.ts <400, and record mutant/assertion/restore outcomes under the comment cap.

FINAL VERIFICATION — run the task's exact foreground/unpiped PowerShell command: `& {$p='pnpm.exe';function x{&$p @args;if($LASTEXITCODE){exit $LASTEXITCODE}};x --filter @moe/core exec vitest run src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-evidence.test.ts;x --filter @moe/core typecheck}`. Require exit 0, Core `Test Files 1 passed` and a nonzero `Tests` line; exit 0 without counts is unverified. Then, as standalone foreground legs, run `pnpm.exe --filter @moe/core test`, `pnpm.exe typecheck`, root-lane-only `pnpm.exe test` (explicitly note apps/** are excluded), `pnpm.exe verify:foundation`, and `pnpm.exe verify:store`. Compare HEAD failures with phase-0 merge-base sets, require the new-failing-path intersection with the four owned paths empty and all owned Core legs green, and disclose foreign red verbatim. Finish with exact-path status/hashes, plain-Node import of the one-line bridge, public arity/roster/golden parity, line caps, and report all four created/modified paths in complete_step/complete_task evidence.

comments.content: CONSUMER EDGE (planning-time, delivered-tree gate): daemon consumer task-642df965071a4a239c1b5bce97bbafc5 declares this leaf in dependsOn and will import/use the hardened public serializer/digest through the existing bare @moe/core edge. This closes the pure-package composition clause; export/loadability alone is not the claim.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Rejected a one-line public try/catch: it still invokes getters/proxy traps, preserves recursive stack overflow, and only converts unbounded work into a late generic refusal. Rejected recursive Object.values/JSON.stringify cloning for the same authority and allocation reasons. Rejected new public reason codes or a barrel export because the seven-code contract and all callers must remain source/byte compatible. Chosen design is a non-barrel internal production module with iterative descriptor-only snapshot plus bounded canonicalization; internal issue tags make otherwise-indistinguishable guard mutations observable while both public APIs continue mapping hostile input to the existing INCOMPLETE tuple. The daemon byte-reader is a separate declared consumer task so core lands first without widening subsystem ownership.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Measured at delivered HEAD 5fe0fdde: `git status --porcelain -- <four paths>` was empty; safe-value TS/JS do not exist; cutover-quiesce-evidence.ts is 269 lines/SHA256 790D12D9D4595DDF5FCE671137252624AF738A428A2EEADA15AAD495F741B034 and its test is 130 lines. Inline calls to the real exports reproduced RangeError on a 20,000-deep citationKey and caller Error/getterReads=1 on an enumerable throwing getter; revoked/ownKeys proxies also throw. Symbol/non-enumerable/prototype extras and sparse arrays currently return ok:true, with sparse arrays canonicalized inconsistently with their counts. `git grep -n -E 'deriveLiveQuiesceEvidenceDigest|serializeLiveQuiesceEvidenceCanonical' -- apps packages tests` found the core unit/barrel surface, daemon snapshot TS/test, migration evidence tests, and current security WIP; exact shape/count grep found core export count 136 and migration refusal roster count 7, neither changes in this row. Dependency edge measured: packages/core/package.json:11 declares @moe/contracts workspace:*; pnpm-lock.yaml importer packages/core lines 187-191 links ../contracts; a same-command-created/deleted compiled probe inside packages/core imported MAX_JSON_BODY_BYTES/MAX_JSON_DEPTH/MAX_JSON_STRING_UTF8_BYTES from bare @moe/contracts and package tsc exited 0, with exact target status empty before/after. Consumer task-642df965071a4a239c1b5bce97bbafc5 declares this row in dependsOn.
planningNotes.risks: Descriptor inspection itself can throw on proxies, Array.isArray can throw on revoked proxies, sparse arrays hide holes from every/map, and Object.keys ignores symbols/non-enumerables/prototypes. Reject proxies before traps and retain a public catch-all. Bound queue/work before allocating result arrays; check UTF-16 length before UTF-8 encoding and account for escaped key/value bytes plus punctuation before joining canonical output. Preserve canonical key ordering and the exact current valid fixture digest; do not make the internal issue tags part of the package barrel/public refusal roster. Current security files are foreign dirty WIP and must remain untouched. New untracked module/bridge require out-of-tree SHA restore proof during drills.

blockedReason: The approved Step-6 exact verification command is unsatisfiable as written. Its first leg is `pnpm.exe --filter @moe/core exec vitest run src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-evidence.test.ts`, while the command runs with cwd packages/core and the loaded Vitest include is repo-relative (`packages/**/*.test.ts`). Fresh execution exits 1 with `No test files found` and no Test Files/Tests counts; this directly violates Step 6's required `Test Files 1 passed` non-vacuity clause and the global verification rail. Positive control `pnpm.exe -C packages/core exec vitest run --root=../.. packages/core/src/cutover/cutover-quiesce-evidence.test.ts` discovers the intended file (`Test Files 1 failed`) and then reaches the intentional Step-2 red: missing `./cutover-quiesce-evidence-safe-value.js`. Amend the exact final command to the root-qualified invocation before implementation continues; do not certify a zero-test lane. Step 1 is complete and green. The declared test WIP has the exact 11-case hostile roster, issue-tag/public-tuple assertions, no-accessor/iterator counters, and the valid canonical/digest golden; no production file was changed.
